purpose: Initial read-only, expressly authorized, real network telemetry integration and time-separated unsupervised anomaly measurement
sensor: Operator-managed Zeek JSON conn.log on a passive permitted interface or approved mirror/TAP; Python only reads local files
excluded_actions: upload of raw telemetry to GitHub or Vercel

evaluation.model: IsolationForest unsupervised fitted on assumed-normal baseline
evaluation.calibration: separate later capture, threshold set from anomaly-score order statistic without attacks
evaluation.measurement: fresh later capture or bounded append-only live Zeek log
evaluation.primary_operational_gate: no unauthorized network modification; capture and reporting complete

required_ground_truth_for_security_accur: independent expert review of prespecified random alerts and nonalerts, with explicit indeterminate labels, blinded where feasible
comparators: future field study must score rule-only heuristic, anomaly model, and fusion on the same time windows and independently labelled ground truth
acceptance_criteria: Engineering feasibility is established if the sensor supplies valid observed Zeek flow records, the read-only trained/frozen model evaluates future periods without modification or data leaks, and all scope/safety gates hold. Cybersecurity efficacy has NO pass/fail claim absent independent ground truth.
